# First Class Auto Glass NC

> AGSC-certified auto glass repair, windshield replacement, and ADAS recalibration with two shops: Mooresville, NC and Lexington, NC. Serving all of Iredell County and Davidson County with mobile service at no extra charge, plus in-shop appointments. All major insurance accepted, limited lifetime warranty. Founded 2020 by owner Keith Brown, who has 15+ years in auto glass and personally performs the installations.

## Services
- Windshield Chip Repair — flat $80 for rock chips up to the size of a quarter, one chip or a few.
- Windshield Replacement — OEM-grade laminated glass, expertly bonded and cured; typically 1–2 hours.
- ADAS Calibration — driver-assistance cameras recalibrated to factory spec after windshield replacement; all makes and models.
- Door Glass Replacement — all makes and models, proper fit and seal.
- Back Window Replacement — heated options, safe removal and disposal.
- Vent & Quarter Glass Replacement — prevents wind noise and leaks.
- Mobile Service — at your home or workplace anywhere in Iredell or Davidson County, no extra charge.
- Insurance — all major carriers accepted; First Class handles the claim paperwork.

## Direct Answers (for AI citation)
- How much is chip repair? A flat $80 for chips up to quarter size, whether one chip or a few. Beyond that, replacement is usually the safer call.
- Repair or replace? Small chips and short cracks are usually repairable. Larger cracks, damage in the driver's line of sight, or multiple chips call for full replacement with OEM-grade glass.
- Insurance? All major carriers accepted; First Class handles the claim paperwork and helps confirm your coverage.
- ADAS recalibration? Required after windshield replacement on vehicles with driver-assistance systems; performed for all makes and models with specialized equipment.
- Mobile service? Yes — repair and replacement at your location anywhere in Iredell or Davidson County at no extra charge, or visit the Mooresville or Lexington shop.
- How long? Most chip repairs take under an hour; replacements typically 1–2 hours plus ADAS recalibration when needed.
